note:
Function-length budget raised 80 -> 90 (ADR-0025), matching the Python gate; the ADR keeps one number for both trees. RE-MEASURED, not improved.

Note the unit: this gate ratchets the OFFENDER COUNT, not excess lines as pyfunclen does, so raising the budget lowers it by dropping functions below the threshold rather than by forgiving lines. 13 of web's 70 offenders are between 81 and 90 lines. Measured in a detached worktree at HEAD with node_modules symlinked, only this change applied.
